_meta.source: Indicative soil characteristics for AgriPilot AI planning estimates.

loamy.label: Loamy
loamy.note: Balanced texture, holds moisture well without waterlogging. Suits most crops.

clay.label: Clay
clay.note: Holds water long. Good for rice, risky for root crops and in heavy rain.

clay_loam.label: Clay loam
clay_loam.note: Retains moisture with better workability than pure clay.

sandy.label: Sandy
sandy.note: Drains fast, needs frequent light irrigation and more organic matter.

sandy_loam.label: Sandy loam
sandy_loam.note: Easy to work, warms early. Good for potato, onion and groundnut.

silty.label: Silty
silty.note: Fertile and moisture-retentive but prone to surface crusting.
